uncited: - Input: Volume dataset organized into blocks, transfer function, viewing transformation (parallel projection assumed for simplification).
**Block Metadata:** Stores minimum and maximum sample values for each block.
**Entry Point Buffer:** Array sized to the image plane.
**Block Visibility Culling:** Identify blocks containing only transparent data.
**Ray Initialization:** In the ray setup phase, use the depth values and block indices from the entry point buffer to calculate the absolute ray start position.
- **Time Complexity:** Depends on the number of visible blocks and their projected area.
The projection step involves iterating over template pixels for each block.
- **Memory Complexity:** Requires storage for the entry point buffer (depth + index per pixel) and block metadata.
